description: Data behind the development-scorecard sections of docs/progress.md. Update and run scripts/build_progress_page.py; never edit the generated page by hand.
headline: Eight pre-registered gates; all seven locked gates have a registered first pass; 48 one-shot candidate runs on the public record.

gates.name: Earnings-history credibility
gates.tests: The backcast earnings process scores against held-out PSID panel moments and geometry blocks, judged against the same-panel noise floor.
gates.first_pass: Candidate 13 (rank_knn_v5, 2026-07-07): 5/5 seeds geometry, 4/5 battery, C2ST 0.523 ≤ 0.53 — after 12 committed failing runs.

gates.name: Family transitions (marital and fertility)
gates.tests: Marriage, divorce, remarriage, widowhood, occupancy, cohort nuptiality, and fertility transitions scored against the PSID marital and childbirth history files.
gates.first_pass: Candidate 16 (hazard_v16, 2026-07-09): 4/5 seeds across all 46 gated cells — after 15 committed failing runs.

gates.name: Household composition
gates.tests: Who lives with whom: coresidence stocks and wave-to-wave transitions from the PSID relationship matrix — spouse/partner, parent, child, grandchild, household size, multigenerational entry and exit.
gates.first_pass: Candidate 9 (hazard_v9, 2026-07-11): 4/5 seeds — after 8 committed failing runs.

gates.name: Marriage × earnings joint
gates.tests: Who marries whom by earnings — assortative mating, earnings-conditional marriage hazards, and couple shared-earnings shape, on which spousal and survivor benefit levels depend.

gates.name: Disability
gates.tests: Work-limitation incidence and recovery hazards, disabled-occupancy prevalence, and near-retirement disability exit, anchored against SSA Disability Annual Statistical Report tables.
gates.first_pass: Candidate 1 (2026-07-12): 5/5 seeds, all 12 gated cells — passed on the first attempt.

gates.name: Representative-frame transport
gates.tests: The PSID-estimated generators transported onto the certified CPS representative frame: 44 gated cross-sectional cells plus SSA administrative margins.
gates.first_pass: Candidate 4 (2026-07-13): 43/43 cells in-band on 5/5 seeds — after 3 failing candidates.

gates.name: Temporal-holdout projection drift
gates.tests: The projection engine fits on data through 2014 only, then projects and is scored on the held-out 2015–2022 window — a genuine out-of-time test.
gates.first_pass: Candidate 3 (2026-07-24): 4/5 seeds across the 11 gated cells.

gates.name: Forward projection
gates.tests: Near-term components resolve against future administrative publications on named resolution rules — scored when the numbers come out.

incumbent_benchmarks.intro: Direct number-for-number comparisons against the incumbent models are registered as a benchmark inventory that fills in as modules land — shown here before launch, deliberately.

items.name: MINT / CBO / SSA benchmark inventory (tranche 2)
items.detail: 60 registered comparison rows against published MINT (19), CBO (30), and SSA Statistical Supplement (11) figures; 58 rows await the modules that compute them. Each row is pinned to the captured source file by hash.

items.name: Cross-sectional incumbent replacement (Enhanced CPS)
items.detail: Archived scorecard: a Microcosm-US candidate against the certified Enhanced CPS 2024 production incumbent on 3,704 calibration targets — candidate loss 0.228 vs incumbent 1.405 (holdout 0.038 vs 0.317). Publication pending in microcosm-benchmarks.
